outcome: Management accounts reviews, drafting, publication, uncertain delivery and the verified result run on the live API
acceptance_criteria: The router picks each board from the read: the five fixtures `4201`..`4205` show reviews, drafting, publishing, uncertain and verified, and `state:'owner_needed'` or `setup_needed` returns `other` — verify: unit test on `accountingBoard.ts`; open `/work/4201` to `/work/4205` against mock 4991 on Next 4990.
The reviews board draws one row per station subject with the API status word and no reviewer name column — verify: open `/work/4201` at 1440 and 390; DOM has no reviewer column.
"Take this review" appears only when `can_claim`; pressing it sends exactly one `POST /tasks/901/claim` with `{expected_revision: 3}` — verify: e2e plus network panel.
Decide verdict buttons are exactly the entries of `verdicts[]`; a verdict outside the list is never drawn or sent — verify: unit test with `verdicts:['approve']` shows one button.

A decision sends `{expected_revision (task revision), verdict, evidence_id, note}` with `evidence_id` from `review_evidence[]`; return and reject cannot be sent with an empty note; on 200 the board reloads — verify: unit test on the body; e2e on `4201`.
With empty `review_evidence` (`4207`) the decide control is disabled with "No review evidence is available yet." and no request is sent — verify: e2e, network panel shows no decision call.
Wrong user: a task with `can_claim:false` and `can_decide:false` has no button; a mock 403 on claim shows the API message and leaves the board unchanged — verify: e2e on both.

A 409 on claim, decision or any accounting write reloads the read and says "This changed while you were looking. Check and try again."; the write is not repeated — verify: unit test counts POSTs (one).
"Check reviewers again" is shown only when `can_recheck_reviewers` and sends `{action:'recheck_reviewers', expected_revision}` once — verify: unit and e2e.

"Reassess" is shown only when `can_reassess`, needs a reason, is disabled when `source_id` is null, and sends the full body with `case_revision` — verify: unit test on the descriptor body and the form.

Invalid input: an empty reassess reason and a note over 2000 characters are refused in the form before any request; a mock 422 shows its first `fields[].message` — verify: unit test, no fetch call on refusal.

The drafting board shows `calculated_at`, the id-backed done lines and `setup_missing[]`; it draws no revenue, cost, allocation count, unallocated amount, step list, "Send for output review" or "Ask Chidi" — verify: e2e on `4202` asserts those texts are absent.

The publishing board lists one row per `delivery_jobs[]` entry with the raw status and "Receipts recorded: N" from `receipt_ids`; no recipient name, no "Received" tick — verify: e2e on `4203` and `4205` fixtures; unit test on the row mapper with an unknown status word.

The uncertain board shows "Check what happened" only when `can_reconcile`; one press sends exactly one `POST /work/{id}/actions {expected_revision, action:'reconcile'}`; a 202 shows "Checking" and never "delivered" — verify: e2e plus network panel.

The page has no resend, retry, cancel or release control anywhere, and the code contains no `release_invoice` call — verify: e2e asserts those buttons are absent; `grep -rn "release_invoice" frontend/src/features/finance/accounts` returns nothing.
While a write is in flight every write button is disabled, so a double press sends one request — verify: unit test with a pending promise.

The verified board appears only with `publication` not null and `state:'verified'`; a job that reports success without a `publication` (state `waiting`, job `sent`) shows the publishing board, never verified — verify: unit test on the router with that input.

`ledger_posted` is shown as "Not posted" on every board with a `publication`; the page contains no text claiming a posting — verify: e2e on `4205`; grep of the board files for "posted to the ledger" shows only the "Not posted" label.
Unknown values read "Not recorded", never 0: `calculated_at:null`, `reviewed_at:null` and a missing date render that way and no money amount is drawn — verify: unit test; e2e on `4202`.
`predecessor_id` and `successor_id` show a read-only link line, and no write is attached to it — verify: e2e on `4208`.

Error states: 401 shows the signed-out link, 403 `forbidden` no-access, 403 `csrf_failed` is not no-access, 404 reads "This record is unavailable." and is the same for missing and not-yours (`4206`), 429 and 503 offer a retry — verify: unit tests with mocked client; open `/work/4206`.

A failed poll keeps the last good board with a "couldn't refresh" note; a 401, 403 or 404 on a poll replaces the page and stops polling; polling runs only on `processing`, `drafting` and `publishing` boards and pauses in a hidden tab — verify: unit test with fake timers.

Live check against Django 8030 (account with a Finance review role) on a real management-accounts work id: the page's state, `next_action`, stations and delivery jobs match `GET /api/v1/work/{id}/accounting` — verify: compare the page with the `curl` JSON for the same id; record the id.

Viewport check at 1440 and 390 for all five boards against the SCR-53 artboards: parts left out leave no empty gap or empty heading, and the stepper (Chidi investigates through Verified) matches the board — verify: screenshots reviewed against `design/screens.md` SCR-53 artboards.
The feature changes nothing under `frontend/src/features/workspace/` — verify: `git diff --stat origin/main -- frontend/src/features/workspace` is empty.

New tests exist for the router, each write body (claim, decision, recheck, reassess, reconcile), the one-press rule and the hidden-part absences; `delivery/checks.sh` passes — verify: test files named above run green.

risk.rationale: High: publication sends the report to external recipients (`delivery_jobs` per recipient). The screen has an uncertain-effect state where a wrong retry would double-send, and review decisions are accountable approvals. Merge goes to the design engineer's merge batch, not D-180/D-184. Surfaces are ui and api (live contract, `accounting` read and write) plus external-messaging. No money posting happens on this screen (`ledger_posted` is read-only). Product acceptance is required because the client sees new publication and recovery flows and their copy.

completion.reason: Project, readiness, implementation and review evidence has not been supplied.
